title: How to create 3D with Gemini and Antigravity
summary: Build 3D scenes and 3D websites with Google Gemini: pick Gemini 4 Argon, Hydrogen or Carbon in Spline, or connect Spline to Antigravity with the Spline skill. With their Spline Arena results.
body_markdown:
Gemini can create 3D in Spline: whole scenes with objects, materials, lighting, animation and interactions, as an editable Spline file. There are two ways to build with Google's models. Pick a Gemini model inside Spline's AI Agent, or connect Spline to Antigravity, Google's coding agent, and build 3D websites from your editor. This guide covers both, and how the Gemini models compare with others in[Spline Arena](https://spline.design/arena) .


## Pick a Gemini model in Spline


Spline's AI Agent offers three Gemini 4 models, each as a tier in its model picker that keeps the model's name:


- Argon


Gemini 4 Argon


Google's flagship, near the top of Spline Arena


- Hydrogen


Gemini 4 Hydrogen


A step behind, faster and cheaper


- Carbon


Gemini 4 Carbon


Rates level with Argon, for a little less per scene


- **Argon** for detailed scenes and long builds: it's among the highest-rated models in Spline Arena, for less than half the cost per scene of the most expensive ones.
- **Hydrogen** is a step behind Argon for about half its cost, and builds in about half the time, for quicker work.
- **Carbon** reasons through agentic, multi-step tasks, and in Spline Arena it rates level with Argon for a little less per scene. A good default for most work.


Spline's **Fast** tier runs on Gemini 3.8 Flash too, for quick edits where speed matters more than detail.


In[Spline Arena](https://spline.design/arena) , where people vote on scenes without knowing which model made them, Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 4 Carbon are among the highest-rated models, level with each other, and Carbon is on its Pareto frontier: no other model scores higher for less. How every model compares is in[Designing with 3D AI agents](https://spline.design/blog/3d-ai-agents) and the live[Rankings](https://app.spline.design/arena/rankings) .


## Create 3D with Gemini inside Spline


In the 3D editor, open the **Agent** tab at the top of the left sidebar. At the bottom of the panel, next to the prompt box, pick **Argon** , **Hydrogen** or **Carbon** in the model picker, and an **effort** level: how much the model thinks before it acts. Argon and Carbon offer Low, Medium and High; Hydrogen adds Extra High. High is enough for most scenes.


Then describe the scene and press Enter. The Agent builds it with the editor's own tools, so every change is a normal edit you can undo, adjust by hand or keep prompting on. Hana's AI Agent has the same pickers.


## Build 3D websites with Antigravity


Antigravity is Google's agentic coding tool. Connected to Spline, its agent builds the 3D part of a site in Spline and puts it in your code:


1. Connect Spline


Install the[Spline desktop app](https://spline.design/download) and open it once: it adds Spline's MCP server to Antigravity for you. Or add Spline's hosted server,` https://mcp.spline.design/mcp` , as a remote MCP server in Antigravity and sign in with your Spline account.


2. Add the Spline skill


The[Spline Agent Skill](https://docs.spline.design/generate/spline-agent-skill) is a single` SKILL.md` file that teaches the agent when to build 3D in Spline instead of writing it by hand, and how to get it right on the first try. Add it to your Antigravity skills.


3. Ask for the 3D website


Describe it: "a landing page with a 3D hero, a sculpture that follows the cursor". The agent builds the scene in Spline, then publishes it and wires the embed or a code export for React, Next.js, Vanilla JS, three.js or react-three-fiber into your project.


Open the file in Spline to adjust the scene yourself at any point; publishing again updates the same link, so the site picks up scene changes without a code change. Every client's setup is in the[Spline MCP server docs](https://docs.spline.design/generate/spline-mcp-server) .


## FAQ


### Can Gemini create 3D models?


Yes. In Spline, Gemini builds 3D scenes and models you can edit: shapes, materials, lighting, animation and interactions. Pick a Gemini model in Spline's AI Agent, or connect Spline to Antigravity. You can export the result as GLB, USDZ or STL, or publish it to the web.


### Is there a Spline skill for Antigravity?


Yes. The[Spline Agent Skill](https://docs.spline.design/generate/spline-agent-skill) works with the Spline MCP server in Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex and other agents that read skills.


### How do I make a 3D website with Antigravity?


Connect Spline to Antigravity, then ask its agent for the site and its 3D scene. It builds the scene in Spline and embeds it in your project. The steps are above.


### Which Gemini model is best for 3D?


Of the Gemini models in Spline's picker, Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 4 Carbon rate highest in Spline Arena, level with each other, and Carbon costs a little less per scene. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is a step behind, but cheaper and faster. The[Rankings](https://app.spline.design/arena/rankings) have the current standings.


### Is it free?


Connecting Spline to Antigravity over MCP works on every Spline plan, including Free: each Spline action counts toward your plan's MCP tool call limits, see[pricing](https://spline.design/pricing) . Inside Spline, the AI Agent runs on the AI credits included with paid plans.
